FapFolder (fapfolder.club) is an independent content aggregator focused on leaked social media content. This app is a read-only client: it renders the site\'s public pages, its own local watch history, and nothing else. No data is sent back to any server except what you explicitly post, and even that is disabled in this client.\n\nAll content is uploaded by third parties. This app does not host any content itself.

Adjust how large the video cards appear on the home and search screens.

• Cards per row — how many cards fit across the screen.
 Change this FIRST to set your target layout.
 Doing so resets Height and Width to the HANiEX default (1.00× / 1.00×).
• Height — how tall the thumbnail is. Change AFTER Cards to fine-tune the shape.
• Width (advanced) — a final width tweak. Only change this if Height
 and Cards do not give you the look you want. Recommended value: 1.00×.

Recommended workflow:
 1) Set Cards per row.
 2) Set Height.
 3) Leave Width at 1.00× unless absolutely necessary.
Changing this resets Height and Width to their defaults (1.00×).
1.00× matches the standard HANiEX card height.
⚠ Not recommended. Leave at 1.00× unless you know what you\'re doing. It stacks on top of Cards and Height and is easy to make look wrong.
